QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_84

question.text: What is the maximum residual maturity limit for corporate debt with residual maturity less than 3 years in Asset Class C?

answer.text: 5% of the corporate bond portfolio of the pension fund
10% of the corporate bond portfolio of the pension fund
15% of the corporate bond portfolio of the pension fund
25% of the corporate bond portfolio of the pension fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Bonds in Asset Class C with residual maturity less than three years are limited to 10 percent of the corporate bond portfolio of the pension fund. The Trap: This is a sub-limit applied against the corporate bond portfolio of the pension fund, not against the overall NPS portfolio. Note: Understanding that this 10 percent cap is measured against the corporate bond portfolio (not the total portfolio) helps explain residual-maturity composition within Asset Class C.
